chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm narrated from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sukūnī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

“There is no harm in a man applying dye and then entering janabah while he is dyed. And there is no harm in the junub using depilatory treatment, undergoing cupping, and slaughtering. But he should not taste anything until he washes his hands and rinses his mouth, for it is feared that leucoderma may result from it.”

Al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, said: When the junub intends purification by ghusl, he should clear himself by urinating so that whatever remains of semen in its passages may come out. If that is not possible for him, then he should strive in istibrāʾ: he should wipe beneath the testicles to the base of the penis and squeeze it to the tip of the glans so that whatever impurity may remain in it comes out. Then he should wash the head of his urethral opening and the place from which semen exits, and if semen has reached his thigh or any part of his body, he should wash it. Then he should rinse his mouth and sniff water three times as sunnah and merit. Then he should take a handful of water in his right hand and pour it over the crown of his head and wash it with it, separating the hair until the water reaches its roots. If he takes water with both hands and pours it over his head, that is more complete. If that suffices for washing his head, beard, and neck to the base of his shoulders, then so be it; otherwise, he should wash with another handful. He should insert his two index fingers into his ears and wash their inner parts with water, joining that with washing their outer parts. Then he should wash his right side from the base of his neck to beneath his right foot with the amount of three handfuls of water or more than that, then wash his left side likewise, and pass both his hands over the rest of his body so that the water reaches all of it.

key_terms.الجُنُبُ: a person in the state of janabah requiring ghusl
key_terms.الغُسْلِ: the ritual bath performed to remove janabah
key_terms.الوَضَحُ: leucoderma or a whitening skin condition feared in this context
key_terms.الِاسْتِبْرَاءِ: clearing the passages before ghusl so residual semen exits

ai.seo_question: What is the method of ghusl al-janabah in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām, and what actions are permissible for a junub person?
ai.summary: This report states some acts that are permissible for a person in janabah and instructs that tasting food should be avoided until the hands and mouth are washed. It also describes the method of ghusl al-janabah, beginning with istibrāʾ and removal of impurity, then washing the head and the two sides of the body so that water reaches the entire body.
